title: Enterprise cost center pool blocks usage
summary: Enable the AI Innovation cost-center pool in the Enterprise tenant and stop usage at its included cap.

steps.title: Open the month with a first draw
steps.description: A week into the billing period Alice consumes 11,000 of the AI Innovation cost center's 38,900 included credits.
steps.expected: Usage is accepted from the cost-center pool, leaving 27,900 included credits.

steps.title: Continue drawing down the pool
steps.expected: Usage is accepted from the cost-center pool, leaving 18,400 included credits.

steps.title: Pass the halfway mark
steps.description: A further 10,300 included credits are consumed.
steps.expected: Usage is accepted from the cost-center pool, leaving 8,100 included credits.

steps.title: Consume most AI Innovation credits
steps.description: Alice consumes 8,000 more credits, bringing cost-center consumption to 38,800 of 38,900.
steps.expected: Usage is accepted from the cost-center pool, leaving 100 included credits.

steps.title: Try to exceed the included allowance
steps.description: Alice tries to consume 200 more AI credits after only 100 remain in the AI Innovation pool.
steps.expected: The complete event is blocked because the cost-center included allowance is exhausted and the enterprise AI credit paid usage setting is disabled.
